top_signal.title: What is the best pricing and package structure for a small web development agency?
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone,   I'm looking for advice from experienced web agency owners and freelancers.   I'm building a small web development business targeting established SMEs. Our services include business websites, e-commerce, booking systems, custom web applications, automation and digital marketing.   Our vision is not simply to build a solution and hand it over. We want to help clients beyond development by providing business advice, suggesting ways to promote their products or services, and helping them make better use of their digital presence.   I'm trying to establish competitive but profitable packages.   A few questions:   Would you recommend three fixed packages (Starter, Professional, Premium) or customised quotations?   What services and benefits should each package include?   How do you price projects while protecting your profit margins?   Do you recommend one-time payments with optional monthly maintenance or monthly subscription packages?   Should digital marketing advice and business growth guidance be included in packages or offered separately?   What additional value can an agency offer to stand out from competitors?   I'd appreciate practical advice, real-world examples and honest criticism.   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/01JN09       [link]       [comments]
